goals: Verify user registration and login functionality, including success and failure scenarios.
Verify medical professional registration functionality, including success and failure scenarios.
activities: Check that the Node environment is set to 'testing'.
Send a POST request to '/api/auth/user-register' with user registration data (email, password, name).
Assert that the response status code is 201.
Send a POST request to '/api/auth/user-login' with user login credentials (email, password).
Assert that the response status code is 200.
Assert that the response body contains 'token'.
Assert that the response body contains 'message'.
Send a POST request to '/api/auth/user-login' with incomplete user login credentials (only email).
Assert that the response status code is 401.
Send a POST request to '/api/auth/med-register' with incomplete medical professional registration data (only email).
Assert that the response status code is 404.
Send a POST request to '/api/auth/med-register' with complete medical professional registration data (email, password, first name, last name, company, position).
Assert that the response status code is 200.
